title: IO normalization and regression sentinel contract for pinned releases
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Introduce a machine-readable IO normalization and regression sentinel contract that sits between the pinned-model manifest and runtime.`
`Goal: Ensure stable prompt/parameter semantics and measurable behavioral drift for pinned versions so customers can rely on fixed I/O shapes, parameter aliases, and documented perf envelopes. This ticket defines the contract, the sentinel test suite, perf-profile fingerprinting, and the minimal runtime shim required for normalization and soft-fallbacks.
proposal: We will publish a contract artifact (canonical prompt schema + parameter alias map + output shape spec + perf fingerprint) alongside each pinned model release. The runtime will load the contract during handshake and enforce normalization rules for incoming requests (whitelisted parameter names, default coercions, and canonical prompt pre-processing). A regression sentinel harness will run on every release candidate: it executes a curated prompt corpus and validates semantics and performance against the published fingerprint and thresholds. Degradation beyond thresholds triggers an automatic canary rollback or flow-level soft-fallback to a compatible model variant.
acceptance_criteria: A contract JSON artifact is generated by model onboarding tooling for pinned models and uploaded to model registry (fields: version, canonical_prompt_schema_v1, parameter_alias_map, expected_output_shape, perf_fingerprint_sha256, perf_bounds).
Runtime handshake accepts the artifact and returns a validation status in the model manifest API and logs a structured event to tracing/console for adopters.
A normalized request path is implemented that maps aliases (e.g., max_tokens -> max_new_tokens) and coerces parameter types per contract rules without changing semantics for valid inputs.
Regression sentinel suite runs on pre-prod for each release candidate and fails the rollout when semantic drift (classification/intent mismatch) exceeds 2% or latency P95 deviates beyond perf_bounds.
Documentation and quickstart sample (Node/Python) demonstrating how to pin a model with contract verification is published in the onboarding docs and linked from the Console.
E2E tests (unit + integration) exist: contract parsing, alias resolution, sentinel evaluation, and rollback trigger path are covered in CI.
Owners: Model onboarding team and runtime infra sign off on contract format and runtime enforcement behavior.
design_decisions: Use a small stable JSON schema (canonical_prompt_schema_v1) instead of a complex protobuf to keep artifacts human-readable and editable by SRE/PMs.

Represent perf_fingerprint as SHA256 over a canonicalized perf snapshot (median latency, P95, throughput at workloads) plus a small telemetry sample to detect regression without leaking customer data.

Implement parameter alias mapping as a first-class map in the contract to avoid runtime heuristics; aliases are resolved deterministically and logged at DEBUG level for the first 1000 requests post-rollout.
Enforcement is opt-out for existing customers for the first rollout wave (soft mode) and opt-in required thereafter; hard enforcement will be gated by DevEx adoption metrics.

Fallback behavior: when sentinel fails during CI, block rollout; when runtime detects live drift exceeding thresholds, switch to specified fallback model or enable request-level throttling and alert ops.
testing_plan: Develop a curated sentinel corpus covering syntactic and semantic prompt categories for each onboarded model family.
Automate perf snapshot collection in staging using the same traffic mix as production workload simulators.

Add CI job 'sentinel-check' that runs for every pinned-model PR: validates contract JSON schema, executes corpus, and compares outputs using deterministic matchers (token-level equality for strict tests, embedding/intent similarity for tolerant tests).
Introduce mutation tests that intentionally change alias names or output shapes to verify that sentinel and runtime enforcement catch regressions.
Add chaos scenario: simulate partially applied normalization (e.g., double alias) to ensure safe fallback route is exercised.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Deploy contract enforcement in soft-mode for internal Dedicated tenants and Redwood staging for 72 hours; collect logs and evaluate false positives.
Phase 2 (beta): Enable in Console as opt-in for private deployments with clear banner and auto-generated contract diff in UI.

Phase 3 (general): Hard-enforce normalization for newly onboarded pinned models and require contract artifact on manifest upload; offer migration guidance and deprecation notices for legacy pinning flows.
Rollback triggers: failed sentinel in CI, live drift alarm, or customer-reported regressions categorized as P0/P1.
implementation_notes: Perf fingerprint algorithm: canonicalize perf snapshot JSON -> stable stringify -> SHA256. Store both fingerprint and the raw snapshot for debugging.

Runtime shim responsibilities: validate schema, compute request normalization plan, apply alias map, emit structured event 'contract.normalization.applied', and attach normalization metadata to request trace.
Telemetry: add contract_status and sentinel_result tags to existing tracing span; surface contract diffs in Console's model version page.
GitHub PR template: link to ONBOARDING-CHKLIST and sentinel run output URL.
